title: Run migrations through the db:migrate script, not prisma migrate directly
description: Schema changes in the API are applied with the workspace script so fixtures get seeded.
body: In packages/api, schema changes must be applied with `pnpm --filter api db:migrate`, which wraps `prisma migrate deploy`, regenerates the Prisma client and seeds the test fixtures from test/fixtures/seed.ts. Running `npx prisma migrate dev` directly skips the fixture seed, so the integration tests in packages/api/test/integration fail with missing rows for `Tenant` and `PriceList`. Seen on task T-301 where the coder ran the CLI by hand and the reviewer sent it back twice.

title: Store money as integer minor units
description: Billing amounts are whole cents in the Money type; never floats.
body: In packages/billing all amounts are integers in minor units (cents) using the `Money` type from packages/billing/src/money.ts. Never use JavaScript number floats like 19.99 for prices: rounding errors showed up in invoice totals on task T-412. Convert user input at the edge with `Money.fromDecimalString(value, currency)` and format with `Money.format`.

title: Build TanStack Query keys with the queryKeys factory
description: Query keys come from lib/query-keys.ts so invalidation works.
body: packages/web uses TanStack Query. Always build keys with the factory, e.g. `queryKeys.orders.detail(id)` from packages/web/src/lib/query-keys.ts. Hand-written arrays like ['order', id] are not invalidated when mutations call `queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.orders.all })`, so pages show stale data after a save.

title: Start the test database before running e2e tests
description: Playwright specs need the Postgres test container and TEST_DATABASE_URL.
body: Playwright tests under packages/web/e2e need the Postgres container: run `docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d db` first and export TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://test@localhost:55432/shop. Without it every spec times out at the login step after 30 seconds and the failure message does not mention the database.

title: Use the structured logger, not console.log
description: API code logs through the pino logger so request and tenant ids are attached.
body: Services in packages/api must log with `log` from src/observability/logger.ts (pino), which attaches requestId and tenantId. console.log output is dropped by the log shipper and fails the `no-console` lint rule in CI.

title: Run pricing-svc unit tests without the slow marker
description: Use the pytest marker filter in the inner loop; the slow suite takes 40 minutes.
body: In services/pricing-svc run `poetry run pytest -m "not slow"` while iterating. The slow-marked tests retrain the elasticity model and take about 40 minutes. CI runs the full suite nightly, so a task does not need to.

title: Check feature flags with the tenant context
description: flags.isEnabled must get the tenantId or it returns the global default.
body: Use `flags.isEnabled('new-checkout', { tenantId })` from packages/api/src/flags/index.ts. Calling isEnabled without the tenant returns the global default, so tenant-level rollouts silently do nothing for the pilot tenants.

title: Do not edit the generated API client
description: packages/web/src/api/generated is produced by codegen from openapi.yaml.
body: Files in packages/web/src/api/generated/ are produced by `pnpm codegen` from packages/api/openapi.yaml. Manual edits are overwritten on the next build. To change a type, change openapi.yaml and run codegen.

title: Format dates in the tenant's time zone
description: Stored times are UTC; render them with formatInTimeZone and tenant.timeZone.
body: Order timestamps are stored in UTC. In the UI and in emails format them with `formatInTimeZone(date, tenant.timeZone, pattern)` from date-fns-tz. `new Date().toLocaleString()` uses the server zone and showed wrong delivery dates for Australian tenants.

title: Batch line-item loads with the DataLoader
description: Order.lineItems must use ctx.loaders.lineItemsByOrder to avoid N+1 queries.
body: The GraphQL resolver Order.lineItems in packages/api/src/graphql/resolvers/order.ts must use `ctx.loaders.lineItemsByOrder.load(order.id)`. Fetching per order with `prisma.lineItem.findMany({ where: { orderId } })` caused 300 queries for one orders page.

title: Stripe webhook signature check must use the raw body
description: Skip the JSON body parser on the Stripe webhook route.
body: The Stripe webhook handler in packages/billing/src/webhooks/stripe.ts verifies with `stripe.webhooks.constructEvent(rawBody, sig, secret)`. Express `json()` middleware must not run for /webhooks/stripe, or verification fails with 'No signatures found matching the expected signature'.

title: Dynamic Tailwind classes must be safelisted or mapped
description: Interpolated class names are purged from the production CSS.
body: packages/web builds badge colours from status names (`bg-${color}-100`). Tailwind cannot see such classes at build time and drops them. Either add them to the safelist in tailwind.config.ts or map each status to a full literal class string in src/components/StatusBadge.tsx.

title: Bump the cart cache version when the Cart shape changes
description: Redis cart entries carry CART_CACHE_VERSION; change it with the type.
body: Redis entries written by packages/api/src/cache/cart-cache.ts are JSON prefixed with CART_CACHE_VERSION. If you add, remove or rename a Cart field, increment CART_CACHE_VERSION; otherwise old entries deserialize into the new type and checkout throws for every shopper with a saved cart.

title: Terraform changes go through the plan workflow
description: Never apply infra/terraform locally; the tf-plan workflow plans and applies.
body: Changes under infra/terraform/** must be applied by the `tf-plan` GitHub workflow (.github/workflows/tf-plan.yml), which posts the plan on the PR and applies on merge. Do not run `terraform apply` locally: the state lock in the S3 backend gets stuck and blocks everyone.

title: Keep i18n keys in sync across locales
description: Every new key in en.json also goes in de.json and fr.json.
body: When adding a string to packages/web/src/i18n/en.json, add the same key to de.json and fr.json (the English text is fine as a placeholder until translators fill it). The `pnpm i18n:check` CI step fails on any missing key.

title: Call the pricing service through the retrying client
description: Use pricingClient.quote(); raw fetch to PRICING_URL has no retries.
body: Calls from packages/api to the pricing service go through `pricingClient.quote()` in src/clients/pricing.ts, which retries 429 and 503 responses with jittered backoff. A raw `fetch(PRICING_URL + '/quote')` bypasses this and fails under load tests.

title: Update Vitest snapshots deliberately
description: Run vitest -u only for the spec you changed and read the diff.
body: Vitest snapshots in packages/web/src/**/__snapshots__ capture rendered emails. Run `pnpm vitest -u <path>` only for the file you changed and review the snapshot diff. Updating every snapshot at once hid a broken unsubscribe link on task T-388.

title: Mock the pricing service in API unit tests
description: Use vi.mock for the pricing client in unit tests.
body: Unit tests in packages/api/test/unit should mock the pricing client with `vi.mock('../src/clients/pricing')`. The real pricing service is slow and flaky in CI, and unit tests should not depend on it.

title: Squash migrations before merging
description: Combine a task's Prisma migrations into one before merge.
body: If a task created several Prisma migrations, combine them into one with `prisma migrate diff` before merging, so packages/api/prisma/migrations stays readable and reviewers see one change.

title: Use optimistic updates for cart quantity changes
description: Update the query cache in onMutate and roll back on error.
body: On the cart page in packages/web, update the TanStack Query cache optimistically in `onMutate` when a quantity changes and roll back in `onError`. Waiting for the server round trip made the stepper feel laggy.

title: Use the @/ path alias for imports in web
description: Import with @/... instead of long relative paths.
body: In packages/web import with the @/ alias (for example `@/components/Button`), configured in tsconfig paths and vite.config.ts. Relative paths like ../../../components break when files move.

title: Keep Playwright retries at two in CI
description: retries: 2 in playwright.config.ts absorbs flaky network to the test db.
body: packages/web/playwright.config.ts sets `retries: process.env.CI ? 2 : 0`. Keep it: the CI network to the test database is occasionally slow and the retries keep the pipeline green.

title: Cache pricing quotes for 60 seconds
description: pricingClient.quote results may be cached in Redis briefly.
body: Results of `pricingClient.quote()` can be cached in Redis for 60 seconds keyed by sku and tenant. It cuts load on the pricing service by about 70 percent on catalogue pages.

title: Use UUID v7 for new primary keys
description: New tables use database-generated, time-ordered UUIDs.
body: New tables in packages/api/prisma/schema.prisma use `@default(dbgenerated("uuid_generate_v7()"))` for ids, so ids sort by creation time and indexes stay compact.

title: Add an index for every foreign key in schema.prisma
description: Prisma does not index relation fields on Postgres for you.
body: Prisma does not create indexes for relation scalar fields on Postgres. For every relation in packages/api/prisma/schema.prisma add `@@index([orderId])` (or the matching field). LineItem lookups by orderId were full table scans until this was added.

title: StatusBadge needs an aria-label for colour-only states
description: Colour alone does not tell screen-reader users the status.
body: packages/web/src/components/StatusBadge.tsx shows some states only as a coloured dot. Add `aria-label={t(`status.${status}`)}` so screen readers announce the status; the accessibility audit flagged it.

title: Make Stripe webhook handling idempotent
description: Store event ids and skip events already processed.
body: Stripe retries webhooks. In packages/billing/src/webhooks/stripe.ts record `event.id` in the processed_events table inside the same transaction as the side effect, and return 200 early if it is already there. Duplicate invoice.paid events double-credited accounts.

title: Set a TTL on cart cache entries
description: Cart entries without expiry filled Redis.
body: packages/api/src/cache/cart-cache.ts must write with `redis.set(key, value, { EX: 7 * 24 * 3600 })`. Entries written without a TTL filled the Redis instance in staging and evicted session keys.

title: Keep the pricing client timeout below the gateway timeout
description: pricing.ts timeout must be under 10 seconds.
body: The API gateway cuts requests at 10 seconds. Set the timeout in packages/api/src/clients/pricing.ts to 8 seconds (including retries) so the API can return a clean 503 instead of the gateway's 504.

title: Read the Playwright baseURL from the environment
description: playwright.config.ts baseURL comes from E2E_BASE_URL.
body: In packages/web/playwright.config.ts set `use.baseURL` from `process.env.E2E_BASE_URL ?? 'http://localhost:5173'` so the same specs run against preview deployments.

title: Use ICU plural syntax in translation files
description: Counts in en.json use {count, plural, ...}.
body: Strings with counts in packages/web/src/i18n/en.json must use ICU plurals, e.g. `{count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}`. String concatenation like count + ' items' cannot be translated correctly for German or French.

title: Use Decimal for tax rates in schema.prisma
description: Tax rates need four decimal places; Float loses precision.
body: Declare tax rates in packages/api/prisma/schema.prisma as `Decimal @db.Decimal(6,4)`, not Float. Float rates produced 0.0699999 and failed the tax reconciliation report.

title: StatusBadge must handle unknown statuses
description: A new status from the API crashed the badge switch.
body: packages/web/src/components/StatusBadge.tsx switches on status. When the API added 'partially_refunded' the component threw. Keep a default branch that renders a grey badge with the raw status text.

title: Pass --skip-seed to db:migrate in preview environments
description: The fixture seed collides with real data in preview deployments.
body: `pnpm --filter api db:migrate` seeds test fixtures. In preview environments that already hold demo data, the seed fails on unique keys. There run `pnpm --filter api db:migrate -- --skip-seed`. Locally and in CI keep the default.

title: Log per-item loops at debug level
description: Info-level logging inside order item loops exceeded the log quota.
body: Inside loops over order items in packages/api use `log.debug`, not `log.info`, from src/observability/logger.ts. Info lines per item pushed the log volume past the monthly quota during the holiday sale.

title: Flag checks in background jobs take the tenant from the job payload
description: Jobs have no request context; pass job.data.tenantId.
body: Background jobs in packages/api/src/jobs have no request context, so `ctx.tenantId` is undefined there. Call `flags.isEnabled(name, { tenantId: job.data.tenantId })`. The order-confirmation email job ignored the new-checkout rollout because of this.

title: Money: JPY and KRW have zero minor units
description: Money.fromDecimalString needs the currency; yen has no cents.
body: `Money.fromDecimalString` in packages/billing/src/money.ts must be given the currency. JPY and KRW have zero minor units, so multiplying by 100 overcharged Japanese customers a hundredfold on task T-455. Use `Money.minorUnits(currency)`.

title: On Apple Silicon the test db service needs an arm64 image
description: The postgis image in docker-compose.test.yml is amd64 only.
body: On M-series Macs the `db` service in docker-compose.test.yml (postgis/postgis:15) runs under emulation and takes minutes to start, so e2e specs time out. Use the `postgres:16` image locally or set `platform: linux/arm64` with the arm build.

title: Build the API before running codegen
description: codegen reads the bundled openapi.yaml from packages/api/dist.
body: `pnpm codegen` reads packages/api/dist/openapi.yaml, the bundled spec with $refs resolved. Run `pnpm --filter api build` first or the generated client in packages/web/src/api/generated is built from a stale spec.

title: Use pnpm, not npm or yarn
description: The repo is a pnpm workspace.
body: Install and run scripts with pnpm. `npm install` creates a package-lock.json and breaks the workspace links; CI rejects any lockfile other than pnpm-lock.yaml.

title: Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
description: feat:, fix:, chore: prefixes drive the changelog.
body: Use `feat(scope): ...`, `fix(scope): ...` and so on. The release workflow builds the changelog from these prefixes, and commitlint fails the PR otherwise.

title: Resize product images in the upload worker
description: Use sharp in the worker, not in the request.
body: Product image uploads are resized with sharp in packages/api/src/jobs/image-resize.ts. Doing it inside the upload request blocked the event loop for seconds on large images.

title: Rate limit public endpoints
description: Wrap public routes with the rateLimit middleware.
body: Every unauthenticated route in packages/api must use `rateLimit({ windowMs, max })` from src/middleware/rate-limit.ts. The password reset route was abused before this.

title: Email templates are MJML
description: Write emails in MJML under packages/web/emails.
body: Transactional emails are MJML files in packages/web/emails compiled at build time. Hand-written HTML tables broke in Outlook.

title: Pin numpy below 2 in pricing-svc
description: The elasticity model pickle needs numpy 1.x.
body: services/pricing-svc/pyproject.toml pins `numpy = "<2"`. The trained elasticity model is a pickle that fails to load with numpy 2. Do not bump it without retraining.

title: GraphQL schema changes need a changelog entry
description: Add a line to API-CHANGELOG.md for each schema change.
body: Any change to packages/api/src/graphql/schema.graphql needs an entry in docs/API-CHANGELOG.md; the mobile team reads it before each release.

title: Production secrets come from SSM through config.ts
description: Never read .env files in production code paths.
body: packages/api/src/config.ts loads secrets from SSM Parameter Store at boot. Do not add new `process.env` reads for secrets or ship .env files in the image.

title: Use the pnpm migrate wrapper for schema changes
description: Apply schema.prisma changes with the workspace script.
body: When you change schema.prisma, apply it with the workspace script (pnpm --filter api db:migrate) instead of calling the prisma CLI yourself. The wrapper also refreshes the generated client and re-seeds fixtures; calling the CLI on its own leaves the seed out and the integration suite then breaks on absent tenant and price-list rows.

title: Prices must not be floating point
description: Keep billing amounts as whole cents.
body: A send-back on the invoice PR: totals were off by one cent because a price was kept as 19.99 in a float. Billing code represents amounts as whole cents through Money (src/money.ts) and parses user input with Money.fromDecimalString. Keep it that way.

title: Hand-written cache keys break invalidation
description: Use the central key factory for queries.
body: After editing the order detail page, the list did not refresh after a save. Cause: a literal key array. Use the central key factory in lib/query-keys.ts so that invalidating the orders root also clears detail entries.

title: e2e login timeouts mean the database container is down
description: Bring up the test Postgres before Playwright.
body: If all Playwright specs hang on the sign-in step, the test Postgres is not running. Bring up the db service from the test compose file (port 55432) and set TEST_DATABASE_URL before running pnpm e2e.

title: console.log is stripped in production
description: Use the pino logger in the API.
body: Debug lines added with console.log never appeared in CloudWatch. The API's pino logger in observability/logger.ts adds requestId and tenantId and is the only output the shipper keeps; the CI lint also rejects console calls.

title: Skip slow-marked tests when iterating on pricing
description: Filter out the slow marker during a task.
body: Full pytest in the pricing service retrains the elasticity model, about 40 minutes. During a task use the marker filter so only fast tests run; the nightly job covers the slow ones.

title: Per-tenant flag rollouts need the tenant id passed
description: Pass tenantId in the flag context.
body: The new-checkout rollout looked broken for the pilot tenant; the code called the flag helper with only the flag name. Pass the tenant id in the context object every time you check a flag.

title: Regenerate the client instead of patching it
description: Generated client edits are lost.
body: I patched a type in the web app's generated API folder and the next codegen run wiped it. The source of truth is the API's openapi.yaml; edit that and run codegen.

title: Delivery dates shown a day off for Australian shops
description: toLocaleString uses the server zone.
body: toLocaleString picks the server's time zone. Render stored UTC times with date-fns-tz formatInTimeZone and the tenant's configured timeZone.

title: Order list page made hundreds of queries
description: Use the request-scoped loader for line items.
body: Each order fetched its line items with its own findMany call. Use the request-scoped loader on the context (lineItemsByOrder) in the order resolver.

title: billing/src/webhooks/stripe.ts: constructEvent fails
description: 400 on /webhooks/stripe.
body: Mounted bodyParser.json globally, then 400s on /webhooks/stripe. Fix: express.raw({type:'application/json'}) on that route only. See stripe.ts L18-L40.

title: StatusBadge colours missing in prod build
description: StatusBadge.tsx classes purged.
body: StatusBadge.tsx interpolated class names; purge removed them. Used a STATUS_CLASSES map with literal strings. tailwind.config.ts safelist also works.

title: cart-cache.ts CART_CACHE_VERSION
description: Increment on Cart shape changes.
body: Renamed Cart.items to Cart.lines; prod checkout 500s for an hour from stale redis. Increment the constant on shape changes.

title: infra/terraform: no local apply
description: Use tf-plan.yml.
body: State lock stuck after a local `terraform apply`. Use .github/workflows/tf-plan.yml; it plans on the PR and applies on merge.

title: i18n:check failing
description: en.json key missing elsewhere.
body: Added checkout.summary.taxNote to en.json only. de.json and fr.json need the key too.

title: src/clients/pricing.ts quote()
description: Load test failures from raw fetch.
body: Load test failures from raw fetch(PRICING_URL + '/quote'). Route through pricingClient.quote; it has backoff on 429/503.

title: __snapshots__ / vitest -u scope
description: Do not update all snapshots.
body: `vitest -u` across the repo masked email regressions. Limit it to the touched spec path and read the snapshot diff.

title: Do not mock the pricing client in API tests
description: Use the contract stub instead of vi.mock.
body: A mocked pricingClient hid a contract change in the quote response (the currency field was renamed). In packages/api tests use the pricing-svc contract stub started by `pnpm test:stubs` instead of vi.mock for the pricing client.

title: Never squash or rewrite committed migrations
description: Leave each migration folder as created.
body: Squashing Prisma migrations that were already applied in staging broke `migrate deploy` with a checksum mismatch. Leave each folder in packages/api/prisma/migrations as created; add a new migration to fix mistakes.

title: Avoid optimistic updates for cart quantity
description: Wait for the server before changing totals.
body: Optimistic quantity updates showed prices the server then rejected because of stock limits, which confused shoppers. On the cart page wait for the mutation response before changing cart totals.

title: Use relative imports in packages/web, not the @ alias
description: The alias breaks the Storybook build.
body: The @/ alias is not resolved by the Storybook builder and broke stories. Use relative imports in packages/web/src.

title: Set Playwright retries to zero
description: Retries hide real races.
body: Retries hid a real race in checkout: the spec passed on the second attempt. Set `retries: 0` in packages/web/playwright.config.ts and fix flaky tests instead.

title: Never cache pricing quotes at checkout
description: Checkout must use the live price.
body: Cached quotes served stale promotional prices after a promotion ended; legal requires the live price at checkout. Always call pricingClient.quote fresh in the checkout flow.

title: Use cuid() for primary keys, not database-generated UUIDs
description: uuid_generate_v7 is missing in the test container.
body: `dbgenerated("uuid_generate_v7()")` needs a Postgres extension that the test container lacks. Use `@default(cuid())` in schema.prisma for new tables.
